patthana18.5:1.1: hetuṃ āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:2.1: hetuṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca,
patthana18.5:3.1: na hetuṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:4.1: hetuṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:5.1: hetuṃ āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava.
patthana18.5:6.1: hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:7.1: hetuṃ āsavaṃ ceva sāsavaṃca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:8.1: hetuṃ sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na anāsavo ceva na no āsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.5:9.1: hetuṃ āsavaṃ ceva āsavasampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na āsavo ceva na āsavavippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.5:10.1: na hetuṃ āsavavippayuttañceva no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na āsavavippayutto ceva na no āsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.5:11.1: na hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu āsava vippayutto na sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, (lokiya sadisaṃ.)
patthana18.5:12.1: hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, na hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavañca na hetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu āsavavippayutto na anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
